    """Find a sub-multiset of pool summing to target (greedy backtracking)."""
    items = sorted(pool, reverse=True)

        if remaining == 0:
            return []
        if i >= len(items) or remaining < 0:
            return None
        taken = rec(i + 1, remaining - items[i])
